title: カスタマ・リレーションシップマネジメント
subtitle: Customer Relationship Management
keywords: CRM 2.Customer segmentation 3.Individual customer agent 4.CLV 5.Customer communication process
educationalGoal: This course is for achieving "Management Ability" which is the learning and education goal of the Management Information Department. Corporate activity is about creating new value for customers and, as a result, continuing to generate profits. Understand and develop the process design to realize and improve it, and the requirements and methods to achieve it. Specifically, Kotler & Keller marketing management is used as a textbook and linked the contents of Part 2 to practice with special lectures by external speakers.
advice: [Outline of the class (how to proceed)] ○ Lectures on various marketing themes every time. In this course, you will learn about the basic concepts of marketing, Creating customer value, satisfaction and loyalty, ③ Consumer market, Business market, ⑤ Clarification of market segments and targets Mainly learn. ○ In class, use PowerPoint and whiteboard together. Identify important keywords and points and discuss them through group discussions and discussions on case studies. Deepen understanding of the theory. In addition, we will try to use video and online information to learn effectively. 【advice】 ○ It is very important to actively participate in classes every time. Absence, lateness, and poor attitude are strictly prohibited.
books: Marketing Management Phillip Kotler & Kevin Lane Keller
requiredKnowledge: Please keep in mind the following points and learn with interest. 1. Preparing for the lesson. 2. During the class, you need to not only learn the explanations. 3. When discussing a case, ask questions at the time of commentary and actively participate in the discussion. Studies related to "marketing", "database mining", "information service construction", "business process analysis", etc.

activityGoals.body: Explain the concept and importance of Customer Relationship Management (CRM).
Explain the concept and importance of customer segmentation.
Explain the five traps that are likely to fall when deploying customer segmentation and the countermeasures.
Understand and describe the importance of developing CLV (lifetime value of customer).
Understand and describe examples of companies that are effectively deploying CRM.
Explain how to approach according to customer's purchasing interest and knowledge of selection.
